map.公证费参考计算器 使用指南: Notarization Fee Reference Calculator User Guide
map.整理国内常见公证事项（如合同、继承、委托）的收费标准参考，按地区与事项类型给出费: Organizes fee reference information for common Chinese notarization items (contracts, inheritance, authorizations) and gives a fee range by region and item type, helping people anticipate notarization costs; standards vary by region.
map.填写「标的金额（元，财产类用）」。: Enter the subject amount (CNY, for property items).
map.填写「公证书份数」。: Enter the number of notarial copies.
map.填写「是否需要翻译」。: Enter whether a translation is needed.
map.办理财产、合同、遗嘱、继承等公证前，按标的额或件数估算公证费。: Before handling property, contract, will or inheritance notarizations, estimate the fee from the subject amount or the number of documents.
map.财产类按标的额分段累计，合同类有独立费率。: Property items are tiered by subject amount, while contract items have their own rate schedule.
map.需附加副本费、翻译费的，合并估算总额。: Add copy fees and translation fees where applicable and estimate the combined total.
map.房产继承公证 200 万: Property inheritance notarization of 2 million CNY
map.：财产公证：≤20 万部分 1.2%（2400），20–50 万 1%（3000: Property notarization: the portion at or below 200,000 CNY at 1.2% (2400), 200,000-500,000 at 1% (3000), 500,000-1,000,000 at 0.8% (4000), 1,000,000-5,000,000 at 0.6% (6000), totaling about 15,400 CNY (standards vary slightly by region).
map.：遗嘱公证基础费约 400 元/件，另加副本费（每份约 20 元）与翻译费（按字: Will notarization has a base fee of about 400 CNY per document, plus copy fees (about 20 CNY each) and translation fees (by word count) and similar.
map.公证费全国统一吗？: Is the notarization fee uniform nationwide?
map.不统一，由各省价格主管部门会同司法行政部门制定，各地标准有差异，实际以当地公证处: It is not unified; each province sets it with the price authority together with the judicial administration, standards vary by region, and the local notary office's published rates govern.
map.加急和上门收费吗？: Is expedited and on-site service charged extra?
map.加急、外出调查、上门服务等通常另行收费，具体咨询承办公证处。: Expedited service, off-site investigation and on-site service are usually charged separately; ask the handling notary office.
